decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ event adds the new fiat-buyer section but leaves the baseline FAQ directive retaining obsolete one-click prize-claim wording. The baseline copy must also reflect direct wallet delivery.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For viewing the ebook, could we make read-only the default, with a large button on the email certificate labeled "Read 'My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal' Now" and an optional smaller link labeled "Download PDF for Offline Reading"?
Add a PDF.js viewer to the dashboard/email link.

cool?

We also need to add that FAQ.

There should be a new section explaining how non-crypto fiat buyers receive commissions and prizes. This is crucial for normies: a non-custodial wallet is created for them behind the scenes with no seed phrase, but they may not understand how to access their rewards.
Maybe something along these lines:

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?":

If you're paying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and are new to crypto, there's no need to worry—the process is built to be straightforward. When you mint the book for $15 through Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically set up for you in the background, with no seed phrase required. That wallet stores your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes.

The process works as follows:
During the Purchase:
Transak converts the fiat to crypto and mints the NFT directly to a newly created wallet address for you.
There is nothing you need to configure manually—the experience is seamless and non-custodial (you control the keys, without having to manage a complicated seed phrase right away).
Your confirmation email will contain your mint number (which is your referral code), the NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on [URL_002].

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Give people your referral code (for example, "use 8421"). Whenever someone uses it to mint, $5 is sent automatically to your wallet address.
To collect: Sign in to your dashboard on [URL_002], either through the email link or via SIWE with the wallet created by Transak. Your commissions show there instantly, with no action required. If necessary, we'll guide you through exporting to a bank account or exchange (e.g., via Coinbase).

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $500/$10,000 Draws):
Every referral awards you tickets for the active prize draws, automatically linked to your NFT/wallet.
The draws occur on-chain using fair randomness—every ~100 sales for $500 and every ~10,000 sales for $10,000.
Winners are announced on the Winners page and are also notified by email.

To collect a prize: If you win, the $500 or $10,000 amount is sent directly to your wallet.
Look for notifications in your dashboard/email.

faq_baseline_copy.directive: Use the complete revised FAQ Q&A supplied in message 146, but replace its block-prize quantities and cadence with Small Block: 1 × $500 every 100 sales and Big Block: 1 × $10,000 every 10,000 sales, and replace one-click prize-claim wording with direct delivery of prize winnings to the winner's wallet.
notable_copy_revisions: Add a zero-guarantee disclaimer to the future governance-token statement.
Explain that no-code mints send commission and tickets to a random existing NFT holder.
State that the referral code also appears directly on the NFT.
Clarify wallet requirements for fiat minting, commissions, prize tickets, and later trading.
State that active prize tickets transfer with a sold NFT.
Revise the founder-allocation and fiat-fee explanation.
Update the prize explanation to Small Block: 1 × $500 every 100 sales and Big Block: 1 × $10,000 every 10,000 sales.
Replace the one-click prize-claim link with direct prize delivery to the winner's wallet and Winners-page, dashboard, and email notifications.

faq_fiat_buyer_rewards_section.heading: How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?
content_requirements: Explain background creation of a non-custodial wallet without requiring a seed phrase initially.
Explain that Transak converts fiat and mints the NFT directly to the created wallet.
Explain that the confirmation email contains the mint number and referral code, NFT details, and dashboard link.
Explain dashboard access through the confirmation-email link or SIWE with the provisioned wallet.
Explain that $5 referral commissions are sent automatically to the provisioned wallet and displayed without a collection action.
Provide guidance for exporting rewards to a bank account or exchange when needed.
Explain that prize tickets are linked to the NFT and wallet and that the on-chain draws occur approximately every 100 and 10,000 sales.
Explain Winners-page and email notification and direct delivery of prize winnings to the wallet.

decisions.reason: The source changes collection of prize winnings, while coded referral commissions were already delivered automatically to the recipient wallet.
Automatic delivery of a Big Block prize changes the separate winner-collection flow, not the Big Block draw, ticket, funding, or winner-selection mechanism.
Automatic delivery of a Small Block prize changes the separate winner-collection flow, not the Small Block draw, ticket, funding, or winner-selection mechanism.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces one-click claim copy with direct wallet payment and notification language.
The existing same-message MODIFY already states that fiat-buyer prizes are sent directly to the provisioned wallet and accessed through dashboard and email notifications.
Direct transfer of prizes to winners does not necessarily remove or change prize-pool yield generation, and the source does not resolve the existing Aave lifecycle ambiguity.
The prize payout destination does not alter how the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired tickets behave when an NFT is transferred.
The same source already independently introduces email notification for prize winners; no additional modification is required from the automatic-payout decision.
Changing how a winner receives a prize does not change the per-sale founder, commission, or prize-pool allocations.
Automatic prize payout does not change the secondary royalty amount, founder allocation, pool funding, or ticket-generation rules.
The existing same-message Transak event captures fiat conversion and automatic mint initiation; prize delivery occurs after a prize win and does not modify the fiat mint integration.
